signal.mechanism: Contraction of banks' cross-border net dollar funding may accompany dollar scarcity/risk aversion that persists after publication and supports USD versus RUB. This is a testable hypothesis, not established causality; row29 also changes with bank assets and nonseasonally-adjusted balance-sheet effects.

Four sample release tables/values and calendar metadata seen before seal; full monthly states, candidate targets and economic outcomes not computed. No ML, hyperparameter search or fitted threshold. Zero is the literal contraction boundary.
